title: Sometimes Changing the World is Tiring and Mundane
excerpt: This great piece from Ashley Nicole Black and Samantha Bee gives us all an important reminder (a couple, actually). Cooking a meal, writing or inputting data, handing out flyers, giving people rides, nondramatic actions … all these things can add up to produce dramatic results…
body:
This great piece from Ashley Nicole Black and Samantha Bee gives us all an important reminder (a couple, actually). Cooking a meal, writing or inputting data, handing out flyers, giving people rides, nondramatic actions … all these things can add up to produce dramatic results. Little seeds. Day after day.

 Don’t lose heart, friends. Shine some light where you are today.
